item.question: What are the advantages of using a self-supervised learning framework for syllabic embeddings?
item.answer: A self-supervised learning framework allows the Sylber model to bootstrap its own unsupervised syllabic segmentation, leading to highly structured and robust representations. This approach enhances efficiency by reducing information loss during compression and supports better generalization across diverse datasets.
